title: How Feedback-Free Self-Evolution Reshapes Agent Skills: A Systematic Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.25534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent skills are documents in which experts write down procedural knowledge, and models increasingly maintain them by rewriting them without feedback. Such rewriting could adapt a skill to the model that uses it or erode the expert knowledge that makes it useful, yet how skills evolve under this feedback-free self-evolution has not been studied. We let models rewrite expert skills round after round without any task, run or judgment and run agents built on the same models with the rewritten skills. Our experiments show that the skills lose value rather than improve, as every model we test performs worse with them on every benchmark, by 15 points on average on SkillsBench after thirty rounds. Sampling each model's prior with skills it writes from the topic alone, we find that rewriting pulls skills toward this prior and gives up first the knowledge outside it. translated_title: 无反馈自我进化如何重塑智能体技能：一项系统性研究
translated_abstract: 智能体技能是专家记录程序性知识的文档，而模型越来越多地通过在无反馈的情况下重写这些文档来维护它们。这种重写既可能使技能适应使用它的模型，也可能侵蚀使其有用的专家知识，然而技能在这种无反馈自我进化下如何演变尚未得到研究。我们让模型在没有任何任务、运行或评判的情况下一轮又一轮地重写专家技能，并用重写后的技能在基于相同模型构建的智能体上运行。实验表明，技能非但没有提升反而失去价值：我们测试的所有模型在使用这些技能时在所有基准测试上的表现都变差，三十轮后在 SkillsBench 上平均下降 15 分。通过让每个模型仅凭主题自行编写技能来采样其先验，我们发现重写会将技能拉向该模型自身的先验，并首先舍弃先验之外的知识。而将这些知识重新放回即可恢复大部分损失的通过率，因此专家的……
tldr: 该研究首次系统考察了大模型在完全无反馈条件下对专家技能文档的自我进化式重写，发现这一过程会使技能退化而非改进——重写把技能拉向模型自身先验、优先舍弃先验之外的专家知识，导致三十轮后在 SkillsBench 上平均下降 15 分，而补回被舍弃的专家知识可恢复大部分性能损失。
en_tdlr: This systematic study shows that feedback-free self-evolution degrades rather than improves agent skills, as iterative rewriting pulls skills toward the model's own prior and discards knowledge outside it first—causing an average 15-point drop on SkillsBench after 30 rounds—while restoring that discarded expert knowledge recovers much of the lost performance.
